inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, exposing a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up, people. They are playing right out of the standard playbook, putting on a scripted theater for the masses while the hidden puppet masters pull the strings behind the scenes. 

Look at what they are admitting is happening in plain sight: "The split happens as certain MPs bring up the possibility of a fresh discussion regarding the party's leadership." It is all orchestrated chaos designed to distract us from the real agenda. They want you to focus on the surface-level drama where Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. But ask yourself, whose interests are *really* being served by this manufactured clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival? It’s a controlled opposition strategy to keep the public divided.

And notice the obedience test regarding the global controllers: "the opposition leader did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump while declining to state whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran." They are completely beholden to external masters, carefully walking a tightrope to appease the international syndicate pulling the strings of this war. They think we are blind to the coordination, but the real narrative is hiding in what they refuse to say.
